_doc: Plan 065 phase 2 tool-choice eval. Each question names the acceptable FIRST tool call. 'any': the first tool_use in the reply must match one option. 'some': a tool_use in any position of the reply must match one option (a two-part question whose calls run together). An option {"answer": [text, ..]} accepts a reply with no tool call whose text holds every text: only where the snapshot states the exact figure. 'holdout' questions are never used to tune the prompt; they check that the tuning did not over-fit. 'all': the reply must hold a tool_use matching every option (a batch in one reply). 'then': a canned tool_result is sent back for every tool_use of the first reply, and the next reply is scored the same way. Input specs: a literal (strings compare case-insensitively), {"contains": s}, {"prefix": s}, {"any_of": [..]}, {"absent": true} (the call leaves the key out). 'history': earlier user and assistant turns sent before the question, for a follow-up. 'index' (Plan 066): does the model read a record's details instead of trusting the snapshot summary, also when the user disputes an answer; its control questions check that it does not read what the snapshot states. See README.md.
